title: Does Covishield Cause Blood Clots - Learn the TRUTH
description:
AstraZeneca recently admitted that its COVID vaccine (Covishield in India) can, in very rare cases, cause a side effect known as thrombosis with thrombocytopenia syndrome (TTS). The media and anti-vaxxers jumped on this, spreading fear and panic. But what’s the actual science?

In this documentary, Pale Blue Thoughts breaks down the facts. TTS is a serious condition — blood clots with low platelet count — but the risk is 4 in a million. Compare that with the risk of clotting from COVID infection itself (5–25%), or even the odds of dying in a car crash, lightning strike, or bee sting. Fear of vaccines is misplaced .

We explain why rare side effects are always studied, published, and transparently included in vaccine leaflets from day one. There was no U-turn, no cover-up. Even the current lawsuit in the UK doesn’t change the science: vaccines save lives. Covishield prevented millions of hospitalizations and deaths during the Delta wave in India, when people were gasping for oxygen and struggling to survive.

If you’ve searched for Covishield blood clot risk, AstraZeneca vaccine fear, vaccine side effects explained, thrombosis and vaccine, or anti-vaxxer propaganda debunked, this video gives you the evidence-based perspective.
